claims.head: Crash the net vs. Bombs away
claims.body: The Wild get in close, but the Bruins mostly shoot from distance. Minnesota is one of the league’s best for shots from in close, and Boston is one of the worst. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Wild to do more of their damage around the net.

MIN.head: The Wild should be favored
MIN.body: Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back. It’s on the Bruins to make it a game, and they can if they keep the shots coming.

BOS.head: The Bruins are up against it
BOS.body: Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back. The Bruins can still win it if they keep the shots coming, but a lot has to go their way.

story.head: Two good teams
paras: The Wild are 1-0-0. The Bruins have won two in a row. Two good teams meet.
The Bruins shoot a lot, and the Wild give up plenty. Both teams like a fast game.
